tasks.gr9-visual-arts-t4: Topic: Visual Arts. Cover portfolio selection and curation, exhibition planning and display design, finishing techniques (framing, mounting, matting), critical reflection writing, artistic growth demonstration, professional presentation, moderation standards, and creative careers awareness. Ask Grade 9 learners to select portfolio pieces, plan exhibitions, apply finishing techniques, write reflections, explain growth, discuss presentation choices, and explore creative career paths.
tasks.gr9-music-t4: Topic: Music. Cover final performance preparation and rehearsal refinement, aural skills (interval, rhythm, chord identification), score reading fluency, music career exploration, stage etiquette and professionalism, theory revision, musical maturity demonstration, and listening analysis comprehensiveness. Ask Grade 9 learners to prepare performances, identify musical elements by ear, read scores fluently, discuss music careers, demonstrate etiquette, revise theory, and analyze listening examples.
tasks.gr9-drama-t4: Topic: Drama. Cover final production staging and technical elements, technical theatre roles and support systems, acting evaluation criteria, design choices and visual storytelling, teamwork and collaboration assessment, audience impact analysis, drama career exploration, and reflection on production learning. Ask Grade 9 learners to stage productions, understand technical roles, evaluate acting performances, explain design choices, assess teamwork, analyze audience impact, and explore drama careers.
tasks.gr9-dance-t4: Topic: Dance. Cover final choreography refinement and polish, timing and synchronization precision, polished performance with expression and confidence, dance communication and thematic meaning, appreciation of diverse forms and traditions, community performance opportunities, peer feedback and reflection, and artistic maturity demonstration. Ask Grade 9 learners to refine choreography, perfect timing, perform expressively, explain communication intent, appreciate diverse styles, identify community opportunities, and reflect on artistic development.
